datePolicy: All cited URL access dates retain the original source-specific date recorded in sources.md and the original research notes, 2026-11-06. This includes the explicitly failed gov.scot access attempt, not a claimed successful body read. Localization on 2026-11-06 used retained files only, with no external research, refresh or workbook-engine rerun. The 2026/27 model is not a verified 2027/28 tax table. Future filing dates are scenario applications of recorded annual rules.
uncertainties: The annual Scottish sole-trader model excludes employment income, pension relief, student loans and other adjustments; it is not a January–April 2027 first-return forecast. The personal cash target includes no separate pension or emergency reserve.

Capacity, spending, package effort and fees are authored assumptions, not official tariffs, supplier quotes or guaranteed demand. Costs must actually be incurred and allowable; private use and equipment/accounting treatment need individual checking.

2027/28 Scottish bands were not confirmed in the retained material. Income Tax and NI need checking before a different tax year; future Commercial Payments Bill commencement and transition were unconfirmed.

The market sources are platform means and recruitment bands with different methods. No Glasgow-only sample or harmonised day length, VAT or agency-margin basis exists here. YunoJuno and Represent publication days are unconfirmed; Represent fieldwork dates are undisclosed.

The contract is an unsigned B2B Scottish-law starting template, not legal advice, legal approval or an enforceability guarantee. Liability, cancellation, IP and insurance fit need a Scottish solicitor. Consumer use requires different consideration.

Whole-project full payment plus approved expenses is the template condition for signed assignment of owned final bespoke work. Earlier launch needs a separate written licence; third-party assets and embedded pre-existing materials retain separate rights. Cancellation payments alone do not transfer unfinished-work rights.

The deposit is credited, not automatically forfeited. The proposed cancellation component is up to 20% of unperformed design fee, constrained by evidenced reasonable loss, mitigation, credits, refunds and the design-fee cap; it is not a statutory automatic entitlement.

PI advertisements are dated starting examples, not personalised or comparable quotes. PolicyBee's advertised turnover ceiling is below this model turnover; Hiscox supplies no matching cover limit beside the price. Twelve-month multiplications are not annual-payment quotes.

Original discovery routes were not provably fresh; retained notes disclose existing managed browser routes and a failed gov.scot renderer attempt. Saved unauthenticated public snapshots do not establish current availability. No private-account content was needed.

The older independent-review findings about the high-income boundary and contract ambiguities are superseded by its final bounded-fix section. Current workbook formulas contain the corrected taxable boundary and invalid-day guard. This authoring pass read actual DOCX text and XLSX ranges/formulas/cached values, without claiming a fresh engine recalculation or render.
editingContract: New English-only local draft. No Chinese-language need specific to this Glasgow Scottish sole-trader scenario was established, so no Chinese file or speculative locale is declared. Four source-supported FAQ entries. No Review, AggregateRating, stars or invented ratings. Supporting documents use the original stage2-relative ../<run>/<file> convention. Only this new Markdown and JSON were authored; no build, inventory, shared-script, source-file or website changes.
